title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
layout_note: Four towers in a row: the image encoder, then one text tower per objective (text encoder, image-grounded text encoder, image-grounded text decoder), each with its objective box (ITC, ITM, LM) on top. One real caption at the bottom fans out to the three text towers.
grouping: Each tower is a rounded grey frame of its layers; the towers are identical in shape and differ in one block (cross-attention greyed out, causal self-attention in green).
shapes_depth: Flat rounded boxes with pastel fills per layer type, residual adds as circles, the image as a real photo cut into patches.
proposed_highlight: The variants are told apart by the one block that differs in each tower; the objectives are yellow boxes on top of their own tower.
lesson: One tower per objective, all the same shape, each with its loss on top and one shared input fanned out beneath them, makes several objectives read as a comparison.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; remembered venue ICML 2022 (not verified in this session). Card written while studying arrangement (2026-11-15).

arrangement.units: one column per objective, each a framed tower of identical structure; the image encoder is the first column
arrangement.inputs_as: a real photo under the image encoder; one quoted caption at the bottom with a fan of arrows to each text tower
arrangement.losses_at: each objective's box on top of its own tower
arrangement.shared: the image features run along the top as one line with drops into the towers that cross-attend

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: unified vision-language understanding and generation pretraining

insights.structure: Four rounded grey towers in a row (Image Encoder, Text Encoder, Image-grounded Text encoder, Image-grounded Text decoder), each an N× stack of Self-Att / Cross Attention / Feed Forward blocks with residual ⊕ nodes, labelled at the bottom-left.
insights.data: The image is a real photo cut into a 3×3 grid at bottom-left; text is one quoted caption in a rounded box at bottom-centre, entering each text tower with a different prefix ('[CLS]', '[Encode]', '[Decode]') plus a checkered token placeholder; embeddings are flat bars above the first two towers.
insights.emphasis: Towers are identical in shape and differ in one block: Cross Attention greyed out with hatching in the text encoder, Causal Self-Att in green in the decoder; block colours repeat across towers, and the three objectives are yellow boxes (ITC, ITM, LM) on top.
insights.flow: Bottom-to-top inside each tower; one caption fans up to three towers; the image embedding runs along a line across the top of the figure and drops into the Cross Attention blocks of the two image-grounded towers.
insights.avoid: The image line runs over the top edge and crosses unit boundaries to reach two towers, and nothing in the figure states that matching colours mean shared parameters.
